channel.title: Broadcastio
channel.description: Field notes for people who publish.

item.title: Five Mics, One Untreated Bedroom
item.description: In a room with a rug and a bookshelf, the Northline AT-44 was the microphone that stayed on the boom.

item.title: Where a Weekly Show Should Live in 2026
item.description: The same nine-minute essay went to a video page, a podcast feed, and a Sunday letter.

item.title: The Wide Panel Beside the Laptop
item.description: A wide panel by the window took the timeline. The laptop went back to notes.

item.title: Light the Face, Not the Whole Room
item.description: Two diffused sources and a background willing to be dull.

item.title: The Sunday Letter Still Beats the Feed
item.description: A Sunday letter will not win a reach chart. It still produces the replies that change the next episode.

item.title: Vertical Video Grew Up. The Audio Did Not.
item.description: A careful frame, and a voice fighting a collar and a music bed.

item.title: Headphones That Tell the Truth About a Take
item.description: Closed-back headphones catch a bad take on the desk instead of in the replies.

item.title: Captions That Sound Like a Person
item.description: A nine-minute essay took twenty-two minutes to caption once the names were in a list.

item.title: Podcast Hosts for People Who Hate Dashboards
item.description: Hosts sorted by the job they finish: a clean episode, a network console, or a bare feed.

item.title: A Broadcast Desk Without a Renovation
item.description: No new walls. A boom that parks, headphones that stay out, and cables the lens cannot see.
